before.requirement: Reach the destructor's pending-comment release after a reported parse error.
before.reason: The complete before destructor has no pending-last_comment release capability.

after.requirement: Call ucl_parser_free after a reported parse error while parser->last_comment is pending, allowing it to release the saved comment.
after.reason: Comment saving can leave last_comment pending when the following invalid key causes an early error return. The harness cannot enable comment saving and also skips destruction when an error is reported.

claims.reason: The pending-comment release is absent from the before destructor and present in the after destructor. The same old harness cannot reach it under the stated condition.
